content.title: Viavi Solutions’s (NASDAQ:VIAV) Q3 CY2025 Sales Top Estimates
content.summary: Network testing solutions company Viavi Solutions (NASDAQ:VIAV) reported Q3 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 25.6% year on year to $299.1 million. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($365 million at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 22.1% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.15 per share was 14.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
